title: After a successful bulk deactivation the rows leave Active without a reload and the mode ends
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com, S2 shop. Location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as (a) Admin or a default Parts Manager. QAPL-CAP-001…QAPL-CAP-009 are active. DevTools Network tab open with Preserve log on. After the test set QAPL-CAP-001 and QAPL-CAP-002 back to active (Inactive tab > Activate parts).
custom_steps:
1. On /parts/inventory (Active tab) search QAPL-CAP-00 and sort by Part Number in descending order.
  2. ⋮ > Deactivate parts (menu_item_inventory_bulk_status), then click the QAPL-CAP-001 and QAPL-CAP-002 rows.
  3. Click Deactivate on the bulk bar, type the note QA no reload and click Deactivate (button_confirm_part_status_change) in the confirmation.
  4. Look at the list, the bulk bar and the Network log.
  5. Open the ⋮ actions menu.
  6. Click the Inactive tab and open QAPL-CAP-001's Part History (row history icon).
custom_expected:
1. QAPL-CAP-009 … QAPL-CAP-001 are listed in descending Part Number order.
  2. The checkbox column shows; both rows are ticked and shaded; the bar reads "2 selected" and Deactivate is enabled.
  3. The confirmation closes and toast_bulk_status_updated reads "2 parts updated."; PATCH /api/inventory/parts/status returns 200.
  4. QAPL-CAP-001 and QAPL-CAP-002 have left the list without a page reload (no document request in the Network log, only the API calls); the mode has ended: the bulk bar and the checkbox column are gone; the remaining rows QAPL-CAP-009 … QAPL-CAP-003 keep the descending Part Number sort with no stale rows.
  5. The menu offers Cycle count, Deactivate parts and Export again.
  6. The Inactive tab lists QAPL-CAP-001 and QAPL-CAP-002; Part History reads "Deactivated | Reason: QA no reload".
